title: Format text
description: Changes case, trims, replaces, splits, joins, truncates text or formats a number. Runs inside Weav and calls nothing outside.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: upper, lower, trim, replace, split, join, truncate or number_format.

value.title: Text
value.description: The text to change (at most 100000 characters), or a list of texts for join. For number_format, the number written as text or mapped from an earlier step.

search.title: Search
search.description: replace: the exact text to find (not a pattern).

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.description: replace: the text that replaces every match. Empty removes the match.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: split and join: at most 16 characters. Defaults to a comma.

maxLength.title: Maximum length
maxLength.description: truncate: keep at most this many characters, 1 to 100000.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: number_format: digits after the decimal separator, 0 to 6. Defaults to 0.

locale.title: Number style
locale.description: number_format: vi gives 1.234.567,89 and en gives 1,234,567.89. Defaults to vi.
